answer: Verifiers post an on-ledger bond and countersign transactions; anyone caught countersigning an invalid one is slashed by an amount several epochs larger than the maximum reward, with any observer able to submit proof. Fake identities are a pointless voyage: each must bond the same stake, and invalid signatures wander through gossip instantly, so every forged countersignature echoes network-wide and burns the whole bond. Identity is cheap but honesty is expensive, so cheating costs more than any sybil reward.
